body.purpose: The user's terminal monospace font at one size; hierarchy via bold, color, and space only.

components.name: Pill Button (primary)
components.description: Top-bar action pill: tinted at rest, solid on hover/focus — soft-spoken, then certain.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; border: none; padding: 5px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-pill-green { background: rgba(166, 227, 161, 0.15); color: #a6e3a1; } .ds-pill-green:hover, .ds-pill-green:focus-visible { background: #a6e3a1; color: #1e1e2e; outline: none; }

components.name: Pill Button (caution)
components.description: Butter-cream pill for secondary file actions (Open Files).
components.css: .ds-pill2 { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; border: none; padding: 5px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-pill-butter { background: rgba(249, 226, 175, 0.15); color: #f9e2af; } .ds-pill-butter:hover, .ds-pill-butter:focus-visible { background: #f9e2af; color: #1e1e2e; outline: none; }

components.name: Pill Button (destructive-hue)
components.description: Rose-bud pill (New File); rose is the destructive/attention hue.
components.css: .ds-pill3 { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; border: none; padding: 5px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-pill-rose { background: rgba(243, 139, 168, 0.15); color: #f38ba8; } .ds-pill-rose:hover, .ds-pill-rose:focus-visible { background: #f38ba8; color: #1e1e2e; outline: none; }

components.name: Icon Rail Button
components.description: Emoji glyph on transparent; boost wash on hover, 25% primary tint on focus.
components.css: .ds-rail { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; width: 40px; padding: 6px 0; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-rail:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-rail:focus-visible { background: rgba(166, 227, 161, 0.25); outline: none; }

components.name: Tab (active)
components.description: Editor tab: plain label with a catnip-green underline when active.
components.css: .ds-tabs { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; background: #252532; padding: 8px 8px 0 8px; display: inline-flex; gap: 16px; } .ds-tab { color: #6c7086; padding: 2px 4px 6px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e2e6de; } .ds-tab-active { color: #e2e6de; border-bottom-color: #a6e3a1; }

components.name: User Chat Bubble
components.description: The user's message in Cat Me: green text in a rounded box-drawing-style border, max 70% measure.
components.html: how do I undo in the editor?
components.css: .ds-chat-user { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #a6e3a1; background: #252532; border: 1px solid #5a9955; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; max-width: 70%; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Runner Output Panel
components.description: Script output log in a panel border with the catnip prompt line.
components.css: .ds-runner { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; background: #252532; border: 1px solid #3b8d34; border-top-width: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #e2e6de; } .ds-runner-prompt { color: #a6e3a1; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Catnip's interface is the spot a cat actually chooses: a warm, soft-lit place inside a disciplined structure. The structure is the terminal grid — deep velvet dark, exact cell alignment, keyboard-first economy. The warmth is pastel light falling onto it: catnip green, seafoam, peach, and butter tints that appear as washes and accents, never as floods. The result is cozy but never messy; every playful touch (emoji icons, "purr purr" copy, the Cat Me tab) sits on top of a quiet, precise frame.

This is a terminal application (Textual/TCSS). Every styled value is theme-driven: TCSS references semantic variables ($primary, $warning, $error, $panel, $surface, $boost), and the custom catnip theme defines the house palette those variables resolve to. Users can live-switch to any Textual theme from the customizer, so the layout and tint logic must read correctly under any palette — the catnip theme is the authoritative expression, not the only one.
keyCharacteristics: Deep soft dark ground with pastel garden accents, each hue carrying one meaning.
Tonal depth only: translucent washes (15/25/40%) and $boost, never shadows.
Soft-spoken controls that commit fully on interaction (tinted at rest, solid on hover/focus).
Emoji as the icon language; box-drawing round borders as the shape language.
Everything flows with the terminal: fractional/percent widths, fluid at any size.

rules.name: The Theme Variable Rule
rules.body: TCSS never hardcodes a hex value. All color flows through semantic theme variables ($primary, $warning, $error, $panel, $surface, $boost, $background) so the customizer's live theme switching restyles every screen. The catnip theme is where hex lives.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each pastel keeps one job: green = primary/affirm, butter = caution/secondary action, rose = destructive, teal and lavender belong to the editor's syntax voice. Don't borrow a hue for a different meaning because it looks nice.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: The terminal has one glyph size. Emphasis comes from bold, color, and surrounding space. Never fake "large text" with figlet banners or doubled rows in app chrome.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Depth and state are expressed as translucent color washes over the dark ground, never as borders-everywhere or bright fills at rest.

dos: Do route every color through a theme variable and verify new chrome under at least one non-catnip theme (the customizer makes this a one-keystroke check).
Do keep controls soft-spoken, then certain: tint at rest (15%), solid on hover/focus, nothing in between.
Do use relative widths (%, 1fr, auto) so every screen reflows with the terminal; verify at 80×24 and a wide size.
Do keep the cat voice in copy and emoji in iconography — warmth lives in words and glyphs, not extra decoration.
Do cap prose content at a ~90-cell measure.
donts: Don't hardcode hex values in TCSS; hex belongs only in the theme definitions (core/theme.py).
Don't add shadows, gradients, or figlet-style large type — depth is tonal, type is one size.
Don't mix icon languages: no nerd-font glyphs or ASCII-art icons beside the emoji set.
Don't reassign hue meanings (rose stays destructive; green stays primary/affirm).
Don't let any surface depend on a fixed terminal size or absolute column widths.
